goal: The orchestrator computes a pass/fail landing verdict for a task by running operator-registered held-out command graders (excluded from the agent's Task and worktree) against the committed result out-of-band, failing closed when a held-out grader cannot run.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00050-held-out-landing-gate.md -- acceptance criteria #3, #4, #5, #9 and decisions D-2, D-3, D-4, D-5 this task satisfies

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- _drive_under_lease (~line 1080-1252) holds the committed sandbox path, task, and run id; the gate engine is the orchestrator-owned function that grades the committed result there (this task builds the engine; wiring the land decision is the next task)

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/grader_command.py -- run_command_graders is the existing out-of-band command-grader runner (cwd = a working tree, subprocess); reuse it to run held-out command graders against the committed result, do not invent a second runner

packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- _reverify (~line 617-656) is the existing precedent: command graders re-run in a subprocess against a worktree outside the agent's turn; mirror that posture
constraints: Held-out graders are loaded from an operator-owned location keyed by task id that the orchestrator reads. They MUST NOT be added to the Task object handed to the harness/agent and MUST NOT be written into the agent's worktree -- the agent must be unable to read them during its run (D-2).

The verdict is computed from each held-out grader's subprocess exit code against the committed result; the agent's self-reported terminal status is never authoritative (D-4). An agent that reports DONE while a held-out grader exits non-zero yields a FAIL verdict.

FAIL CLOSED (D-3): a registered held-out grader that cannot be located or executed produces a FAIL verdict -- never a pass and never a silent skip. A task with NO registered held-out graders produces a distinct 'no gate' verdict (not a fail).
Held-out graders are command graders only (D-5), evaluated against the committed result as their working tree.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT wire the land/block decision, worktree parking, or outcome recording in this task -- that is the held-out-landing-integration task. This task produces the verdict only.
Do NOT modify flywheel-core: no change to Task, Grader, the lifecycle, the harness verification loop, or core's schema (criterion #11). Add a hidden grader field to Task is forbidden.
Do NOT support held-out transcript/rubric/manual graders -- command only.
Do NOT source held-out graders from the git-ignored .flywheel/verification/ fw-verify scratch; that is throwaway oracle scratch, not the operator-owned held-out grader source.
Do NOT modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions.
edge_cases: A held-out grader that errors on launch (missing file, non-executable, nonzero on startup) MUST yield a FAIL verdict, not a skip or pass -- the fail-closed anti-hack.
A task with no held-out graders registered MUST yield a 'no gate' verdict distinct from FAIL, so the integration layer can land it unchanged.
The held-out grader content must be absent from the agent's worktree during the run and absent from the Task passed to the harness, yet still execute against the committed tree afterward.
